rekey.minLength: The new vault password must be at least 8 characters long.
rekey.mismatch: The new vault passwords do not match.
rekey.noKdfSalt: Your session has no kdf_salt to migrate this legacy vault.

restricted.title: Restricted settings
restricted.description: Only owners and admins can access this project's settings.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.description: This action cannot be undone. This will permanently delete the project and all of its data.

apiKeys.title: API Keys
apiKeys.description: API keys only read: encrypted secrets (for containers and scripts) and, if you want, the audit history. For pipelines that write secrets or sync with hosting providers, use CI tokens.
apiKeys.revokeConfirm: Revoke this API key? Applications using it will stop working.
apiKeys.createdNotice: API Key created — copy it now, it will not be shown again!

form.name: Name
form.allHint: The key reaches every environment, but it does not reach the restricted ones. For a container, prefer a single environment: if the key leaks, only that one is exposed.
form.auditNeedsAll: The audit history covers the whole project: only a key for every environment can read it.

ciTokens.title: CI Tokens
ciTokens.description: Use CI Tokens for automations such as deploys, writing secrets and syncing with providers. Token and API key management remains restricted to the human dashboard session or the CLI.

created.title: Token created successfully!
created.warning: ⚠️ Copy this token now. It will not be shown again.

empty.title: No CI tokens created yet.
empty.hint: Create tokens to integrate with CI/CD pipelines.

modal.title: New CI Token
modal.name: Name *
modal.envHint: Reaches every environment, but does not reach the restricted ones: for those, create a token for that environment only.
modal.envOneHint: The token only reaches this environment.

alerts.title: Expiration alerts
alerts.description: Warn the team before secrets expire. Only owners and admins can change these preferences.
alerts.loadErrorDetail: Could not load alert settings. No changes were applied.

enabled.label: Project alerts
enabled.description: Enables or pauses all expiration alerts.

inApp.label: In-app channel
inApp.description: Shows alerts in the notification center.

email.label: Email channel
email.description: Sends alerts to owners and admins with a verified email.

webhook.label: Webhook channel
webhook.description: Sends a secure payload to the configured endpoint.

alerts.allDisabled: All channels are disabled. No alerts will be delivered.

leadTime.label: Default lead time
leadTime.hint: Per-secret overrides remain available on the Secrets page.

webhook.title: Webhook configuration
webhook.urlHelper: The saved URL is never displayed again in full text.
webhook.urlRequired: Enter a URL before enabling the webhook.

environments.title: Environments
environments.description: Separate variables by stage or by risk. A restricted environment is reached only by the project's creator and its admins.
environments.name: Name
environments.nameHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. It cannot be changed later.
environments.restrictedHint: Developers and viewers neither see nor read this environment. CI tokens and API keys only reach it when created for it.
environments.restrictBody: Only the project's creator and admins will see and read this environment. What was already downloaded does not come back: if someone outside already read these variables, rotate them. CI tokens and API keys already created for this environment keep their access.
environments.archiveBody: The variables of this environment stop being accessible and the name cannot be reused. This cannot be undone from the screen.

errors.name: Use only lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens in the name.
errors.limit: The project has reached the plan's environment limit.
errors.conflict: An environment with this name already exists (archived ones count too).

environments.openBody: The whole project team will see and read this environment, and CI tokens and API keys with no environment set will reach it.
